page_title: UNI 1-1 PAU | Union Berlin v St. Pauli 05/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Tobias Welz blows his whistle and Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' It's time for a substitution. Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli) comes on in place of Mathias Rasmussen.
88' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
85' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Tobias Welz ignores the protests.
84' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
84' Corner kick. Union Berlin will have an opportunity.
83' Alex Kral (Union Berlin) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
82' Alex Kral (Union Berlin) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
80' Steffen Baumgart has decided to substitute Oliver Burke and he is replaced by Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin).
80' Here's the change. Derrick Kohn leaves the pitch and Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) comes on as a substitute.
79' Karol Mets (St. Pauli) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
78' Union Berlin seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
75' One of the players from Union Berlin times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
73' Here is a change. Joel Fujita is going off and Alexander Blessin gives the last tactical orders to Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli).
73' Substitution. Alex Kral (Union Berlin) has come on for Woo-Yeong Jeong.
73' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
71' The Union Berlin players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball.
69' The referee blows his whistle as Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) was too aggressive in his challenge.
69' The free kick from long range, taken by St. Pauli, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
67' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Tobias Welz blows his whistle for an infringement.
63' The ball goes out for a corner. St. Pauli can continue in their attacking effort.
60' Alexander Blessin decides to make a substitution. Martijn Kaars will be replaced by Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli).
60' A sweet pass inside the box gives Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
58' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
55' Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli) sends a long ball in, but Frederik Ronnow comfortably gathers the ball.
52' 1 - 1 Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) gets on the end of the corner and powers a header into the bottom left corner.
51' Union Berlin will take a corner kick.
51' Rough tackle by Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Union Berlin are awarded the free kick.
50' It's a throw-in after the ball crosses the sideline.
47' Union Berlin control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Tobias Welz blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Tobias Welz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli). Union Berlin earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' The ball goes out of play. Union Berlin are awarded a corner kick.
43' Union Berlin enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

40' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Nikola Vasilj anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
38' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from St. Pauli.
36' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) is penalised for a foul. Tobias Welz had a clear view and blows his whistle.
36' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.

33' What a great chance for Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header towards the foot of the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
32' Union Berlin have a corner.

32' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball goes behind for a corner. Union Berlin will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
31' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Union Berlin.
31' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
29' The referee points to the corner flag and Union Berlin will take a corner.

28' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat. The referee blows his whistle, Union Berlin are awarded a corner kick.

25' 0 - 1 Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight under the crossbar. He couldn't have done it any better. 0:1.
24' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) tackles a bit over-zealously and Tobias Welz blows for a foul. St. Pauli earn a free kick.
23' Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
22' Close! Karol Mets (St. Pauli) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
22' St. Pauli take a short corner kick.
20' St. Pauli show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
18' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
16' Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Tobias Welz stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
16' The Union Berlin players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
14' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) but poses no threat.
13' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. St. Pauli get a free kick.
12' Union Berlin are ruled offside.
10' It could have been a good chance to score! Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) fails to release Andrej Ilic with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
7' St. Pauli are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear.
6' Union Berlin are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
5' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Union Berlin.

5' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He sends a shot towards the roof of the net, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save. Union Berlin force a corner. They send men into the box.
4' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Union Berlin.
3' A cross from Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
1' Great teamplay by Union Berlin as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! St. Pauli will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Tobias Welz.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
